mainText: Good morning. Here is your market briefing for Wednesday, October 7th. Futures are lower this morning. S and P 500 futures are down about a third of a percent. Nasdaq futures are down seven tenths of a percent. Dow futures are down six tenths of a percent, about three hundred fifty points. The pullback follows record closes yesterday for the S and P and the Nasdaq, with profit taking, rising Treasury yields, and Brent crude back above one hundred dollars a barrel on Middle East supply concerns. The ten year Treasury is around five point three three percent, in multi-decade-high territory. Federal Reserve September meeting minutes come out at two PM Eastern, ahead of a ten year Treasury auction at one PM. Biggest premarket movers: Brookfield Wealth Solutions, ticker B N T, up fifteen percent. Neogen, ticker N E O G, up fourteen percent after an earnings beat and raised guidance. Molson Coors A, up nearly ten percent. On the downside, Micron down two percent. Constellation Brands down about five percent on weak beer demand. And SpaceX down two percent on a report it is raising forty billion dollars to buy Nvidia chips.
